instruction: Recognize the learned exact card before splitting its visible surface.
OS, RESUME_CARD and TALAM remain memorized whole cards.
Read registered components in card order; do not reorder them silently.
OL continues; OT advances; OS adds; RESUME_CARD resumes the prior material.
Read the stable action component before supplying any pictured object.
AIR water, OR batch and HO ingredient remain distinct material values.
AR source, CKH passage and AL target form the local address chain.
AIN portion, AIIN prescribed measure and IIN stage share a learned setting slot.
E short, EE long and EEE full modify only their own local slot.
Y names the current work item even when its visible surface is dy.
Only licensed DY constructions close; visible letters dy alone do not.
Add plant, basin or station nouns only after the portable card reading.
